newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, softer to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer to mark, softer to dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev gained to 994.70-995.30 per mark at close from the opening's 994.70-996, due to lower foreign currency demand in thin interbank trade, dealers said.
* Most banks with full licenses were more active on the international foreign exchange market, dealers said.
* The central bank was seen as a main foreign currency buyer amid the seasonally low foreign currency demand.
* Under the currency board system the Bulgarian National Bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks, the anchor currency, at a bid of 995 levs and an ask of 1,000.
* The lev lost further to 1,780-1,783 per dollar from the morning's 1,769-1,771 shadowing the mark's fall against the dollar on international markets.
